# Marine Wood Craft

> Marine Wood Craft restores teak decks, brightwork and yacht wood interiors, and offers an ongoing boat-keeper service, in Honolulu, Marina del Rey and San Francisco. 3–7+ years of experience, 50+ vessels restored.

## Locations

- [Hawaii (Honolulu)](https://marinewoodcraft.com/hawaii/): teak decks, brightwork and yacht interiors in Honolulu, Waikiki, Ala Wai Harbor and Hawaii Kai
- [Marina del Rey, CA](https://marinewoodcraft.com/marina-del-rey/): Marina del Rey, Long Beach, Newport Beach and San Pedro
- [San Francisco, CA](https://marinewoodcraft.com/san-francisco/): San Francisco, Sausalito, Alameda and Richmond

## Services

- [Teak restoration](https://marinewoodcraft.com/services/teak-restoration/): teak deck restoration for boats and yachts: sanding, sealing, UV protection
- [Boat keeper](https://marinewoodcraft.com/services/boat-keeper/): ongoing maintenance and monitoring: regular checkups, wash-downs, systems monitoring and woodwork upkeep

## Optional

- [Home](https://marinewoodcraft.com/): overview and free quote
